messages.content: You identify patterns in complete email texts. Respond with valid JSON.

Please write a BRIEF 15-20 word executive summary of the theme "Review and Decision-Making" as it appears in the following examples.
['I seek your consent and permission to present you as the next of kin so that the proceeds valued at $20 million dollars can be paid to you and then we can share the money.', 'If you are interested.', 'To reactivate your account please download the document attached to this email to review your account activity.', 'Could you please notify me of your acceptance to carry out this transaction urgently by e-mail only on the receipt of this message?', 'Click CANCEL to nullify payment, or click CONTINUE to execute payment.', 'CLICK HERE TO CANCEL THE BANK TRANSFER AND VERIFY YOUR ONLINE BANKING CLICK HERE TO CONTINUE THE BANK TRANSFER AND AUTHORIZE YOUR PAYMENT', 'Can you honestly help me as your relation or business partner?', "I'm still active in the university: Visit here to participate and cancel this deactivation request.", 'As we move forward, we just want to confirm that you are still interested in quarantine housing.', 'If this proposal is acceptable to you, kindly email following information to me;', 'feel free to reply me or call me to indicate your interest and willingness to assist me and my younger brother out of this suffering and transfer the money to your bank account in your country.', 'If you accept to work with me, I will appreciate it very much.', 'If you are willing to assist you will have 20% of the initial sum and further 20% of whatever investment we go into.', 'IF YOU ARE READY TO HELP AS MY FOREIGN PARTNER PLEASE I WILL NEED TO HEAR FROM YOU REGARDING THIS PROPOSAL OR YOUR Advice.', 'Accept Decline']

DO NOT write the summary as a third party using terms like "the text examples" or "they discuss", but write the summary from the perspective of the text authors making the points directly.
Please respond ONLY with a valid JSON in the following format:
{
    "summary": "<SUMMARY>"
}
